text:
The bowl appears to hold rice (possibly sticky rice) topped with chunks of orange fruit, most likely cantaloupe or papaya. This looks like a mango-sticky-rice-style dish.

I estimate about 6 fruit chunks at roughly 25 g each, so about 150 g of fruit. Cantaloupe has about 0.34 kcal/g, so the fruit comes to about 51 kcal.

The rice looks like roughly 120 g of cooked rice. Sticky rice has about 1.3 kcal/g, which gives about 156 kcal.

Total mass is about 270 g and total energy is about 207 kcal, which I'll round to 210.
